title: LinkedIn
description: LinkedIn's professional networking palette centers on blue (#0a66c2), with supporting greens, ambers, corals, and neutrals: #83941f, #e7a33e, #f5987e, #56687a, #004182, #44712e, #915907, #b24020, #38434f, #dce6f1, #d7ebce, #fce2ba, #fadfd8, #e9e5df, and #fdfaf5. Colors are drawn from LinkedIn's official brand downloads.
